text: あおいやねで　ＳＨＯＰと　かかれた　たてものが　フレンドリィショップです。

structure.jp: ＳＨＯＰと　かかれた　たてものが
structure.en: the building with "SHOP" written on it

structure.jp: フレンドリィショップです。

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かく becomes かかれる to say the thing has it done to it: 'is written' rather than 'writes'. かかれた = 'was written'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after words shows exactly what is said or written, like quotation marks. ＳＨＯＰと = '(written) as "SHOP"'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ＳＨＯＰと　かかれた　たてもの
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ＳＨＯＰと　かかれた　たてもの = 'the building with "SHOP" written on it'.
